psychological_meaning: Bright red is a stimulating color that evokes feelings of energy, excitement, and passion. It is associated with courage, strength, and power. However, it can also signify danger, aggression, and impulsiveness, depending on the context and culture. It is a color that demands attention and can be used to create a sense of urgency or importance.
